limitations: Does not prove existence or C1 regularity; does not compare singular maximizing paths; f must be C1, positive on [0,1], and nonincreasing. Possible nonobvious coverage by general last-passage geodesic theory remains a historical-priority risk.
scientific_integrity: An analytic at-most-one-maximizer theorem with a constructive nonlinear interpolation. The theorem is conditional on the existence of an optimizer in the specified locally absolutely continuous class; no external certification is claimed.
title: Strict geodesic concavity of the Luce increasing-subsequence path functional
